name: Limpark Bot Monitor
author: limpark

sections.description:
Limpark Bot Monitor is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you monitor search engine bots and crawlers visiting your website in real time.

View which bots are currently online, browse a detailed visit history, inspect requested URLs, HTTP status codes, IP addresses and User-Agent strings, and verify supported search engine bots using reverse DNS.

The plugin starts working immediately after activation and requires no configuration.

Features

  • Real-time monitoring of search engine bots
  • Live online bots dashboard
  • Detailed visit history
  • Built-in statistics
  • Reverse DNS verification for supported bots
  • Automatic log cleanup
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No external services required

Supported Bots

Search Engines

  • Googlebot
  • GoogleOther
  • YandexBot
  • YandexImages
  • YandexMobileBot
  • YandexAccessibilityBot
  • BingBot
  • AppleBot

AI Crawlers

  • GPTBot
  • ChatGPT User
  • ClaudeBot
  • PerplexityBot

SEO Crawlers

  • AhrefsBot
  • SemrushBot
  • MJ12Bot
  • DotBot
  • Common Crawl

Other Bots

  • DuckDuckBot
  • ByteSpider
  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn
  • Slack
  • Twitter
  • Discord
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Limpark Bot Monitor in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Monitoring starts automatically.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require configuration?

No. Limpark Bot Monitor starts monitoring bots immediately after activation.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for minimal performance impact.

Can it verify real search engine bots?

Yes. Supported search engine bots can be verified using reverse DNS.

Which search engines are supported?

Google, Yandex, Bing and Apple.

Which AI crawlers are supported?

GPTBot, ChatGPT User, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot.

Does the plugin collect personal visitor information?

Limpark Bot Monitor does not track regular human visitors. It stores the IP address, User-Agent and requested URL of detected crawlers for monitoring purposes.
